bodyHtml:
🤖 Hands-On AI Training · Logan & Surrounds

Learn About AI Logan. From "I've Heard Of ChatGPT" To Actually Using It.

AI isn't science-fiction any more, it's in your phone's camera, your email spam filter and the cash register down the street. Computer Repairs Logan offers friendly, face-to-face workshops and 1-on-1 coaching that turn AI-curiosity into "I can actually use AI to save time and spark ideas."

Learn About AI
✓ Plain-English Explanations
✓ Security & Ethics First
✓ Tool-Agnostic Tuition
✓ Real-World Demos
Why Learn With Us

Zero Jargon. Just Practical Skills.

Plain-English explanations perfect for beginners and curious seniors. We cover privacy, Australian data laws and responsible use from the get-go, and we're tool-agnostic, try ChatGPT, Claude, Copilot, Midjourney, Canva Magic or Google Gemini, with no brand bias.

Real-World Demos

Learn On Your Own Device, At Your Pace.

Automate email drafts, improve marketing copy, or build a basic chatbot, on your own laptop or phone. We offer a 90-minute intro class, a half-day small-business workshop, or private coaching via Zoom or onsite across Logan.

Who Benefits

AI Training For Every Stage Of Life.

💼

Sole Traders & Freelancers

Draft proposals, tidy spreadsheets, and brainstorm ads faster than ever.

🎓

Students

Summarise research articles, organise study notes, and cite sources properly.

📄

Job Seekers

Polish résumés, practise interviews, and analyse job ads with confidence.

🌴

Retirees & Hobbyists

Write family memoirs, plan trips, and upscale old photos.

🏢

Small-Office Teams

Automate meeting minutes and customer-service replies.

🔐

AI Health-Check Audit

A privacy, data-retention and compliance review for anyone already using AI tools.

Optional Add-Ons

Go Deeper When You're Ready.

  • Small-Business Workflow Workshop. Automate socials, invoices and staff onboarding.
  • Creative Toolkit (Image & Video). For designers, teachers and bloggers.
  • Prompt-Engineering Deep Dive. For power users and IT staff.
  • Student / Teacher Discount Packs. Schools and uni clubs wanting bulk licences.
Learn About AI
Related Services

Round Out Your Tech Confidence.

Want broader digital skills beyond AI tools? Our Computer Training service covers everything from email to spreadsheets at your own pace. Not sure where AI fits into your everyday tech questions? Our General Tech Advice service is a good place to start.

If AI tools mean logging into new accounts and services, get your passwords sorted first with password manager and 2FA setup. Running a business and curious about automating your phones? Ask us about our AI receptionist and answering services.

Ready To Actually Use AI, Not Just Hear About It?

Book a friendly, jargon-free session, onsite, at your desk, or over Zoom.

Learn About AI
